description: Bug fixes, usability improvements, and documentation updates for Agent Skill Manager including orphaned agent cleanup, multi-argument commands, consistent styling, and documentation gaps

tasks.title: Fix bare sm command not showing skills from local repos
tasks.description: After sm repo add /path, running bare sm shows 'No skills or agents found' even though sm repo ls shows skills exist
acceptanceCriteria: sm repo add /path/to/repo adds the repository successfully
Bare sm command shows available skills from local repositories
Skills can be enabled via the interactive selection

tasks.title: Fix sm add -i with local paths
tasks.description: sm add -i /local/path fails with 'Not a valid GitHub skill reference' error instead of showing interactive selection
acceptanceCriteria: sm add -i /path/to/repo shows interactive skill selection
sm add -i ~/path/to/repo shows interactive skill selection
sm add -i ./relative/path shows interactive skill selection
Error message does not reference GitHub specifically

tasks.title: Remove GitHub-specific language from error messages
tasks.description: Error messages still reference GitHub as the primary hosting option when universal git sources are now supported equally
acceptanceCriteria: No error messages specifically mention GitHub as primary option
Messages use generic terms like 'repository' or 'git source'
Help text mentions all supported formats equally (HTTPS, SSH, local paths)

tasks.title: Multi-repo add command
tasks.description: As a user managing multiple skill repositories, I want to add multiple repositories in a single command so that I can quickly set up my environment
acceptanceCriteria: sm repo add accepts multiple repository arguments
All specified repositories are cloned and added to config
Processing continues even if one repository fails
Errors are printed to stderr as they occur
Exit code is non-zero if any operation failed

tasks.title: Multi-repo remove command
tasks.description: As a user cleaning up repositories, I want to remove multiple repositories in a single command so that I can efficiently manage my configuration
acceptanceCriteria: sm repo rm accepts multiple repository arguments
Processing continues even if one repository fails
Exit code is non-zero if any operation failed

tasks.title: Fix orphaned agents on repo removal
tasks.description: As a user, I want agents to be removed when their repository is deleted so that I don't have orphaned entries in my config
acceptanceCriteria: sm repo rm removes all agents associated with the repository from config
Agent symlinks are removed when repository is deleted
No agent entries referencing the removed repository remain in config.toml

tasks.title: Fix file:// URL parsing
tasks.description: As a user adding local repositories, I want lenient file:// URL parsing so that both file:///path and file://path work correctly
acceptanceCriteria: file://Users/dev/skills resolves to /Users/dev/skills (not concatenated with cwd)

tasks.title: Consistent label colors
tasks.description: As a user viewing skill and agent lists, I want consistent color coding for [skill] and [agent] labels so that I can quickly distinguish between them
acceptanceCriteria: Colors are consistent across sm ls, sm (interactive), and sm add -i

tasks.title: Fix interactive mode agent detection
tasks.description: As a user adding skills/agents interactively, I want sm add -i <url> to detect and show agents so that I can enable agents from repositories interactively
acceptanceCriteria: sm add -i <url> scans for AGENT.md files in the repository
Both skills and agents are shown in the interactive selection
UI style matches bare sm command (with type labels)
Labels use consistent colors (cyan for skills, yellow for agents)

tasks.title: Standardize cache location
tasks.description: As a user, I want the cache to be in ~/.cache/agent-skill-manager on all platforms so that the location is predictable and consistent
acceptanceCriteria: sm cache dir outputs ~/.cache/agent-skill-manager (expanded to absolute path)
Cache location is consistent on both macOS and Linux
Does not use platform-specific directories like ~/Library/Caches on macOS

tasks.title: Update README documentation
tasks.description: As a new user, I want the README to document all current features so that I can learn how to use the tool effectively
acceptanceCriteria: README documents sm subagents command group (enable, disable, list)

tasks.title: Update CHANGELOG
tasks.description: As a user upgrading the tool, I want the CHANGELOG to reflect all changes in this release so that I know what's new and what's fixed
acceptanceCriteria: CHANGELOG Unreleased section documents subagent support
CHANGELOG documents universal git source support (local, SSH, any HTTPS host)
CHANGELOG documents all bug fixes from this PRD
